product.name: Ledgerline
product.description:
Ledgerline is a web application for small businesses to keep their accounts, send invoices and reconcile bank statements.
This report covers the web application in a desktop browser. It does not cover the mobile applications.

methods:
Evaluated by the vendor's accessibility team between 1 and 26 September 2026, against Ledgerline 4.2 in production.
Every screen was operated with the keyboard alone, with NVDA 2026.2 and Firefox and with JAWS 2026 and Chrome on Windows 11, and with VoiceOver and Safari on macOS 15. Contrast was measured with a colour picker, and every page was also checked by an automated tool.
The evaluation covered every screen a customer can reach after signing in, the sign-in and sign-up flows, the help centre and the onboarding videos.
notes: Fixes for the cash-flow chart, the invoice grid and the date picker are planned for release 4.3.

criteria.label: Non-text Content
criteria.remarks:
Product images and icons that act as buttons have text alternatives.
The cash-flow chart on the dashboard has no text alternative, so its figures are not available to screen reader users. The same figures are in the cash-flow report's table.

criteria.label: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
criteria.remarks: The product has no audio-only or video-only content.

criteria.label: Captions (Prerecorded)
criteria.remarks: The three onboarding videos have captions, reviewed by the vendor.

criteria.label: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
criteria.remarks: Each onboarding video has a text transcript that describes what is shown.

criteria.label: Captions (Live)
criteria.remarks: The product has no live video.

criteria.label: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
criteria.remarks: Each onboarding video has an audio-described version.

criteria.label: Info and Relationships
criteria.remarks: Headings, lists, tables and form groups are marked up. The invoice line-item grid uses generic containers for its rows, so screen readers do not announce it as a table.

criteria.label: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.remarks: Body text meets the ratio. The grey placeholder text in search fields measures 3.9 to 1 against white.

criteria.label: Reflow
criteria.remarks: Every page reflows to a width of 320 CSS pixels, except the bank reconciliation view, whose two-column comparison is essential to the task.

criteria.label: Keyboard
criteria.remarks: Every function can be operated from a keyboard.

criteria.label: Focus Visible
criteria.remarks: Focus is visible on every control except the date picker's day cells, which show no focus indicator.

criteria.label: Target Size (Minimum)
criteria.remarks: Every target is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels.

criteria.label: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
criteria.remarks: Sign-in accepts password managers and pasting, and offers a passkey.

criteria.label: Name, Role, Value
criteria.remarks: Native controls are used throughout, except the custom account selector, which exposes no expanded or collapsed state.

criteria.label: Without Vision
criteria.remarks: Every function can be used with a screen reader, except reading the dashboard's cash-flow chart; see WCAG 1.1.1.

criteria.label: With Limited Vision
criteria.remarks: The product works with browser zoom to 400 percent and with the platforms' magnifiers.

criteria.label: Without Perception of Color
criteria.remarks: No information is given by colour alone.

criteria.remarks: The onboarding videos have captions; the product has no other sound.

criteria.label: With Limited Hearing
criteria.remarks: The onboarding videos have captions; the product has no other sound.

criteria.label: Without Speech
criteria.remarks: The product takes no speech input.

criteria.label: With Limited Manipulation

criteria.label: With Limited Reach and Strength
criteria.remarks: The product runs on the user's own device and needs no reach or strength beyond it.

criteria.label: With Limited Language, Cognitive, and Learning Abilities
criteria.remarks: Plain language throughout, consistent navigation, and error messages that say how to fix the error.
